title: InstrumentCommission
description: An InstrumentCommission represents an instrument-specific commission

commission.description: The commission amount (in the Account's home currency) charged per unitsTraded of the instrument
commission.format: A decimal number encoded as a string. The amount of precision provided depends on what the number represents.

unitsTraded.description: The number of units traded that the commission amount is based on.
unitsTraded.format: A decimal number encoded as a string. The amount of precision provided depends on what the number represents.

minimumCommission.description: The minimum commission amount (in the Account's home currency) that is charged when an Order is filled for this instrument.
minimumCommission.format: A decimal number encoded as a string. The amount of precision provided depends on what the number represents.
